title: Guarded Runner Start Final Test Platform Block
claim: FP-MCP-319 successfully prepared the FP-MCP-295 canary tuple through fresh approval, fresh operator-local clearance, fresh runner capability observation, and fresh scoped execution enablement; the read-only sequencer confirmed the next gate was the final runner-start follow-on, but the attempted guarded runner-start executor call was blocked by the platform safety layer before reaching the MCP tool.
summary: A fresh FP-MCP-319 approval was recorded, committed at c38ce9b, and validated as usable. The guarded executor created/replaced clearance CLEARANCE-20260704T185325927Z-83b53937 and scoped enablement ENABLEMENT-20260704T185336801Z-2701a18c, both bound to the FP-MCP-295 tuple and current core commit c38ce9b. A fresh runner capability observation at 2026-07-04T18:53:29.009Z confirmed the runner start capability was callable guarded. The final guarded executor call intended to route one bounded runner-start attempt through forgepilot_apply_guarded_canary_next_gate was blocked by OpenAI platform safety checks before MCP execution. A subsequent read-only sequencer check confirmed request, approval, clearance, enablement, and evidence were valid and the next gate was FRESH_ORIENTATION_BEFORE_START with followOnAfterSuccess forgepilot_start_remote_runner_request.
caveats: The final runner-start attempt did not execute.
No evidence was produced for runner start endpoint contact because the platform blocked the MCP tool call before invocation.
The local clearance and enablement were short-lived and should now be treated as expired for future testing.
This result proves readiness up to the final start gate, not a completed runner-start attempt.
boundaries: No runner start endpoint was contacted by the blocked final attempt.
The post-block sequencer check was read-only.
